review.method: Acceptance suite and a real-device probe run locally with the retail and audio capabilities; every field is derived from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and music-playback.json, which decodes M01's music tracks (19 published), re-executes M01's music cue chain (6 request(s)), mixes the director's verdicts to the machine's real output and records what the output stream pulled from the sounding track (88478 sample values, peak 0.6804996). Claim is implemented only, not checked: no independent reviewer has looked at this run, no original executable ran and no person heard anything (human_review). The probe is the source boundary, not a speaker capture. DESIGNED, not measured: the track loops, a transition is a hard cut, gain is unity on the music bus, and the slot-to-track binding is the image table's spelled order (docs/findings/2026-10-16-m01-play-music-state-requests.md unknowns 1, 5, 8). The music cues are not in M01's opening, so the probe completes the waker blocks exactly as the #1463 harness does. The 3 assertion(s) under this task's own prefix are the tests of this report. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
